name: Prizor Viztech Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2017, Prizor Viztech Ltd is a supplier of security and surveillance solutions with a wide range of CCTV cameras[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
PVL is an ISO 9001:2008, ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 27001:2013 certified supplier of video surveillance and TV monitoring solutions and services. It also delivers interactive educational touch panels

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 53.6%
Debtor days have improved from 103 to 80.9 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Working capital days have increased from 130 days to 191 days
